adapter_rule: Shared adapters train on base-label-positive records only after excluding every record positive for any novel label.

base_tuning_checks.limitation: RFMiD has no patient identifiers; duplicate-group separation does not establish patient-independent evaluation. Dataset support counts are not estimates of clinical rarity.

checks.limitation: RFMiD has no patient identifiers; duplicate-group separation does not establish patient-independent evaluation. Dataset support counts are not estimates of clinical rarity.

final_test_policy: No test feature file is loaded or required. Final test remains protected.

selection_rule.base: all primary-grid-eligible labels with at least 50 training positives
selection_rule.novel: all primary-grid-eligible labels with 5 to 49 training positives
selection_rule.warning: This is an operational low-support split, not a claim that RFMiD frequency equals real-world disease rarity.

support_protocols.primary: K positives plus every available training negative
support_protocols.query: all fixed validation records for every method
